# API reference

All functions accept scalars or array-likes and broadcast like NumPy ufuncs. `lower_tail=False` selects R's direct upper-tail algorithm; `log=True` works on the log scale for `d`, `p` and `q` alike.

## Distributions

| accudist | R | notes |
|---|---|---|
| `dnorm(x, mean=0.0, sd=1.0, log=False, *, out=None)` | `dnorm(x, mean = 0, sd = 1, log = FALSE)` |  |
| `pnorm(q, mean=0.0, sd=1.0, lower_tail=True, log=False, *, out=None)` | `pnorm(q, mean = 0, sd = 1, lower.tail = TRUE, log.p = FALSE)` |  |
| `qnorm(p, mean=0.0, sd=1.0, lower_tail=True, log=False, *, out=None)` | `qnorm(p, mean = 0, sd = 1, lower.tail = TRUE, log.p = FALSE)` |  |
| `rnorm(n, mean=0.0, sd=1.0)` | `rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)` | not R's `set.seed()` stream |
| `dunif(x, min=0.0, max=1.0, log=False, *, out=None)` | `dunif(x, min = 0, max = 1, log = FALSE)` |  |
| `punif(q, min=0.0, max=1.0, lower_tail=True, log=False, *, out=None)` | `punif(q, min = 0, max = 1, lower.tail = TRUE, log.p = FALSE)` |  |
| `qunif(p, min=0.0, max=1.0, lower_tail=True, log=False, *, out=None)` | `qunif(p, min = 0, max = 1, lower.tail = TRUE, log.p = FALSE)` |  |
| `runif(n, min=0.0, max=1.0)` | `runif(n, min = 0, max = 1)` | not R's `set.seed()` stream |
| `dgamma(x, shape, rate=None, scale=None, log=False, *, out=None)` | `dgamma(x, shape, rate = 1, scale = 1/rate, log = FALSE)` | `rate` or `scale`, not both |
| `pgamma(q, shape, rate=None, scale=None, lower_tail=True, log=False, *, out=None)` | `pgamma(q, shape, rate = 1, scale = 1/rate, lower.tail = TRUE, log.p = FALSE)` | `rate` or `scale`, not both |
| `qgamma(p, shape, rate=None, scale=None, lower_tail=True, log=False, *, out=None)` | `qgamma(p, shape, rate = 1, scale = 1/rate, lower.tail = TRUE, log.p = FALSE)` | `rate` or `scale`, not both |
| `rgamma(n, shape, rate=None, scale=None)` | `rgamma(n, shape, rate = 1, scale = 1/rate)` | `rate` or `scale`, not both; not R's `set.seed()` stream |
| `dbeta(x, shape1, shape2, ncp=None, log=False, *, out=None)` | `dbeta(x, shape1, shape2, ncp, log = FALSE)` | `ncp=None` -> central algorithm; any value -> non-central |

| `qbeta(p, shape1, shape2, ncp=None, lower_tail=True, log=False, *, out=None)` | `qbeta(p, shape1, shape2, ncp, lower.tail = TRUE, log.p = FALSE)` | `ncp=None` -> central algorithm; any value -> non-central |
| `rbeta(n, shape1, shape2, ncp=None)` | `rbeta(n, shape1, shape2, ncp)` | `ncp=None` -> central algorithm; any value -> non-central; not R's `set.seed()` stream |

## Special functions

These keep Rmath's C names, so `gammafn` sits unambiguously beside `dgamma`.

| accudist | R | summary |
|---|---|---|
| `gammafn(x)` | `gamma(x)` |  |
| `lgammafn(x)` | `lgamma(x)` |  |
| `digamma(x)` | `digamma(x)` |  |
| `trigamma(x)` | `trigamma(x)` |  |
| `tetragamma(x)` | `psigamma(x, 2)` | deprecated in R |
| `pentagamma(x)` | `psigamma(x, 3)` | deprecated in R |
| `psigamma(x, deriv=0.0)` | `psigamma(x, deriv)` |  |
| `beta(a, b)` | `beta(a, b)` |  |
| `lbeta(a, b)` | `lbeta(a, b)` |  |
| `choose(n, k)` | `choose(n, k)` |  |
| `lchoose(n, k)` | `lchoose(n, k)` |  |
| `bessel_j(x, nu)` | `besselJ(x, nu)` |  |
| `bessel_y(x, nu)` | `besselY(x, nu)` |  |
| `bessel_i(x, nu, expon_scaled=False)` | `besselI(x, nu, expon.scaled)` |  |
| `bessel_k(x, nu, expon_scaled=False)` | `besselK(x, nu, expon.scaled)` |  |

## Numerical utilities

| accudist | summary |
|---|---|
| `log1pmx(x)` | log(1+x) - x, accurate for small x |
| `log1mexp(x)` | log(1 - exp(-x)), accurate for small and large x |
| `pow1p(x, y)` | (1 + x)^y, accurate also for |x| << 1 |
| `log1pexp(x)` | log(1 + exp(x)) without overflow |
| `lgamma1p(x)` | lgamma(1+x), accurate for small x |
| `logspace_add(logx, logy)` | log(exp(logx) + exp(logy)) |
| `logspace_sub(logx, logy)` | log(exp(logx) - exp(logy)) |
| `cospi(x)` | cos(pi*x), exact at half-integers |
| `sinpi(x)` | sin(pi*x), exact at integers |
| `tanpi(x)` | tan(pi*x) |
| `fprec(x, digits)` | round x to `digits` significant digits |
| `fround(x, digits)` | R's round(), banker's rounding |
| `fsign(x, y)` | |x| * sign(y) |
| `ftrunc(x)` | truncate toward zero |
| `sign(x)` | -1, 0, or 1 |

## Bespoke wrappers

| accudist | C symbol | why not a plain ufunc |
|---|---|---|
| `pnorm_both` | `pnorm_both` | Writes both lower and upper tail through double* out-params; wrapper returns a 2-tuple of arrays. Cannot be a plain ufunc. |
| `lgammafn_sign` | `lgammafn_sign` | Returns lgamma via return value and the sign via int* out-param; wrapper returns a 2-tuple. |
| `rmultinom` | `rmultinom` | Fills an int* vector of length K; wrapper returns an (n, K) int array. Requires the RNG lock. |
| `logspace_sum` | `logspace_sum` | Takes const double* + length. Expose as a reduction over the last axis, not a ufunc. |

## RNG primitives

| accudist | summary |
|---|---|
| `unif_rand` | Marsaglia-MultiCarry uniform on [0,1) |
| `norm_rand` | standard normal, inversion |
| `exp_rand` | standard exponential |
| `set_seed` | install global (I1, I2) state |
| `get_seed` | read global (I1, I2) state |

## Deliberately excluded `Rmath.h` symbols

| symbol | reason |
|---|---|
| `Rlog1p` | internal alias of log1p |
| `fmax2` | duplicate of numpy.maximum |
| `fmin2` | duplicate of numpy.minimum |
| `imax2` | trivial integer max |
| `imin2` | trivial integer min |
| `R_pow` | duplicate of numpy.power |
| `R_pow_di` | duplicate of numpy.power |
| `R_isnancpp` | internal C++ shim |
| `R_finite` | duplicate of numpy.isfinite |
| `dpsifn` | internal engine behind psigamma |
| `bessel_i_ex` | caller-supplied work array; internal |
| `bessel_j_ex` | caller-supplied work array; internal |
| `bessel_k_ex` | caller-supplied work array; internal |
| `bessel_y_ex` | caller-supplied work array; internal |
| `dbinom_raw` | internal helper; reachable via accudist.rmath only |
| `dpois_raw` | internal helper; reachable via accudist.rmath only |
| `Rtanpi` | R-internal variant of tanpi (returns +-Inf at half-integers instead of NaN); tanpi is exposed |
| `rnbeta` | declared in Rmath.h but implemented in no .c file; rbeta(..., ncp) is composed from rchisq as R does |
